posts.name: Tipa Riot
posts.cooked:
You can talk to the ChatGPT version in EvE discord … if it is still enabled. Discord

My opinion about all of this is, that ChatGPT is pseudo-intelligent, it simulates intelligence without actually being it. It creates content based on what we assume content should look like, look like, not more, whether it’s true or false doesn’t matter. These are real life concepts not part of it.

Also I think that’s why it can’t actually create something truly new, only variations of what existed before. This is of course not a small threat, professions like lawyers, ad designers, ghost writers, some artists, counselors, maybe even teachers will be in “danger” of being supplemented or replaced by AI to some extend.

Humans will be superior in many ways in the time to come, but the entry barrier for some professions will rise. Also we could see usages of AI where it is not suited for, but is used anyway for cost reasons, a 90% fit for zero cost is better than a 100% fit which costs a salary.

posts.name: Aisha Katalen
posts.cooked:
Githany Red:

it got weapons configuration right the tank was correct,better than many fits on zkill

Fits depend on circumstance, use and chosen tactics. A fit that works well for one use doesn’t work well for another. A low sec FW frigate fit won’t work in null, one that is designed for solo pvp won’t work well as a tackler. One that is designed to deal with one (type of) ship might not work well vs another. A fit that is designed to be a kiter won’t work as a brawler.

That means there are two options:

  • one completely specifies use, scenario and tactic and somehow AI finds the exact right answer

  • one doesn’t really actually know much about fits, either because they’re new (fully understandable) or because they’re clueless doing the “one fit fits all” and “I tell newbies to use my afk null anom fit for lvl 2 missions” idiocy. They won’t even realise or notice that the AI is churning out nonsense

Out of those two options one of them is FAR more likely than the other. Especially because the people who are less likely to run in to this… wouldn’t use AI for this in the first place.

It won’t work.
